question: Is a floor level or uneven with pillar feet considered faulty?
premises: The floor is considered in relation to pillar feet and similar elements.
The floor may be equal or uneven.
A judgment about fault is given.
inference: There is no fault whether the floor is level or uneven with the pillar feet and similar elements.
plain_english: There is no fault if the floor is level or uneven with the pillar feet and so on.
